about.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE implementable high-fidelity portrait Android screen '关于考匠' for the Chinese exam study app 考匠 / AceExam. Match the already approved points/check-in language precisely: near-white pale blue #F6F8FC background, clean white 24dp round cards, cobalt #2861F2 accents, deep navy text #182439, restrained mint/lavender/warm amber/coral semantic icon tiles. Flat crisp product screenshot, no hardware frame, no poster captions, no 3D, no coin art, no decorative gradients, no photo background. Natural Noto Sans SC Chinese typography with readable 16sp body and 22sp headings, refined medium/semibold rather than everything bold, rounded outline icons centered in their soft tiles, coherent 8/16/24 spacing, minimum 48dp tap targets. Safe status bar 9:41 and bottom gesture inset. Header: back chevron, centered '关于考匠', no oversized certificate/brand picker. Brand block beneath: one red softly rounded app icon featuring the existing white brush-stroke Chinese character '考', then '考匠 · AceExam', a quiet blue-gray pill '移动端 v1.0.1'. Short introduction '让学习回到每个人手里' in 18sp and '把精练题、碎片时间与 AI 学习放在一起。' in readable muted text. This is an about page, not a promotional landing page. Main white card with small warm amber pen outline icon and title '作者想说'. Concise two-paragraph exact text: '每一个认真学习的人，都应该拥有一条不被费用和时间挡住的路。' and '普通题库免费开放，AI 服务按积分使用。' Under this a quiet disclosure link '阅读完整寄语' with small down chevron, no giant wall of text. Next white grouped rows with subtle separators and 48dp+ height: a small mint document icon plus '字体与开源许可' with a right chevron, subtitle 'Noto Sans SC · SIL OFL 1.1'; a soft blue info icon plus '版本信息', right-aligned 'v1.0.1'. Bottom warm but understated support card: soft coral heart icon, title '喜欢考匠，就支持一下', subtitle '帮助维护题库和改进体验', a modest cobalt rounded button '赞助作者'. Final quiet readable line '愿每次短暂练习，都变成看得见的进步。'. No invented website/legal links, no fake update availability, no claims that user data is local-only, no sales banners, no inflated statistics. Do not clip text or allow labels to collide with corners. Purposeful, softly rounded and polished rather than lavish; make the Chinese lettering genuinely attractive and balanced.

wrong.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished, implementable portrait Android '错题' page for the existing Chinese exam app 考匠 / AceExam. Same approved visual language as the points and daily-check-in screens: pale near-white blue #F6F8FC, white softly rounded 24dp cards, navy text #182439, restrained cobalt blue #2861F2 buttons and selected states, small mint/amber/coral/lavender semantic accents, thin rounded vector-style icons. Full flat mobile screenshot, no phone hardware, no perspective, no poster title, no 3D, no decorative gradients. Beautiful natural Noto Sans SC Chinese system typography, 16sp body, 22sp headings, quiet 14sp metadata, tabular aligned numbers, comfortable line heights, balanced 8/16/24 spacing, 48dp minimum touch targets. Do not make every text bold, do not clip labels or crowd text into rounded corners. Safe top status bar 9:41 and safe bottom gesture area. Header: small softly rounded coral wrong-document icon to the left of title '错题', no repeated large brand name or certificate selector. A short subtitle '找到薄弱点，把易错题逐个攻克'. Under it a compact white metrics card, three aligned columns: '24' with '待巩固题目', '8' with '反复出错', '6' with '涉及知识点'. Numbers are illustrative UI examples, not a real learner record. Section heading '优先巩固', right quiet text '点击定位错题'. One white grouped card with two compact knowledge rows, each at least 60dp: row1 coral-tinted rank '01', title '进制转换', metadata '计算机基础', right '8 题' with smaller '累计错误 14 次'; row2 amber-tinted rank '02', title '电子表格基础', metadata 'Office 应用', right '5 题' and smaller '累计错误 7 次'. Keep full labels readable. No invented accuracy percentages or streak badges. A small muted clock row '到期需复习 6 题'. One full-width rounded cobalt primary button '开始错题复习 · 24 题' with a modest right arrow. Next section '错题清单' and a compact segmented control '全部错题' selected in light blue, and '反复出错' not selected. Below two white question-preview cards with generous 16dp internal padding and soft corners: first a small pale blue '单选题' label and coral '已错 3 次' badge, exact question '将二进制数 101101₂ 转换为十进制，结果是多少？', metadata '计算机基础 · 进制转换', right chevron; second a pale-blue '单选题' label and quiet amber '已错 2 次', exact question 'Excel 中按 F9 时，选中的公式片段会发生什么？', metadata 'Office 应用 · 电子表格', right chevron. Do not expose correct answers on the overview. Persistent bottom navigation of five icons with Chinese captions '今日' '练习' '错题' '考试' '我的', third item selected with a soft blue rounded pill; all icons visually centered and labels complete. Product-first, refined and round, not ornate; avoid excessive blank areas, giant illustrations, extra menus or new unsupported promises.
wrong.refinementPrompt: Edit this existing wrong-question screen, changing ONLY typography scale and vertical density needed to make the two question previews genuinely readable on a 393dp-wide phone. Preserve the same navy/cobalt/white palette, soft 24dp cards, semantic coral/amber icons, all statistics 24/8/6, two knowledge rows, all Chinese wording and five-tab bottom navigation. Critical correction: the question stems are currently too small and too much text is squeezed on one line. Make their font equivalent to 17sp on a 393dp phone (approximately 37px at this reference image width), regular/medium weight and line height 1.5. Each question MUST wrap to TWO readable lines. First exact stem with line break: '将二进制数 101101₂ 转换为十进制，\n结果是多少？'. Second exact stem with line break: 'Excel 中按 F9 时，选中的公式片段\n会发生什么？'. Metadata at least 14sp and badge labels at least 14sp. No truncation, ellipses or clipped characters, no reduced font to fit more data. Keep inner card padding 16dp and add enough card height for two lines. Recover space by making the upper knowledge-priority rows moderately more compact and reducing redundant outer blank gaps; make '到期需复习 6 题' a quiet compact row rather than a tall standalone card. Do not shrink main headings or metrics to compensate. Keep all five nav icons centered and all bottom labels intact, keep the view flat and professionally restrained, remove any obvious gradients from the primary button. This is still one full portrait app screenshot, no hardware or extra captions.
